1. Designates the fields that contain the intended consignee (Ship To) and the Activity (Bill To) to receive the bills and effect payment when applicable.2. Requisitions will cite the Signal Codes which indicate whether the Requisitioner (RP 30-35), the Supplemental Addressee (RP 45-50) or the Fund Code (RP 52-530 is to be used to find the Bill-To address. Marine Corps activities are authorized to use Signal Codes E and N which indicates the Bill-To address is in the remarks field.3. When ASA Signal Code is cited and the item is SFA, the requisition will be rejected citing Status Code CM. If SFA Signal Code is cited and the item is ASA, status BN will be furnished, the Signal Code changed to W or X as appropriate, and supply action continued.4. 1. Used to identify the Document during the entire processing cycle. It is comprised of either a standard DoD document number (DOCUMENT-NUM), a FEDSTRIP agency document number (DOCUMENT-NUM-FEDSTRIP), or a Foreign Military Sales/Military Assistance Program document number (DOCUMENT-NUM-FMS-MAP).2. MAARS-description: the Document Number is constructed in MILSTRIP format and used by all activities for all inputs. The first six positions are the DoD Activity Address Code (DODAAC), the next four positions are the year and Julian date, and the last four positions are the Activity Serial Number.3. A 14-digit reference number assigned to a requisition or a release/receipt document in order to identify the transaction throughout the logistics system until retirement of the document is authorized in official reports of audit.

1. THIS DATA ITEM INDICATES TO THE SUPPLIER THE URGENCY OF THE MATERIEL REQUIREMENTS FOR THE REQUISITIONER.2. A PRECEDENCE APPLIED TO SUPPLY REQUISITIONS, WHICH IS BASED UPON THE REQUESTING UNITS MISSION, FORCED ACTIVITY DESIGNATOR, AND DEGREE OF COMBAT ENGAGEMENT. 3. PRIORITY INDICATES A PRIORITY OF CUSTOMERS RELATIVE NEEDS BASED UPON THEIR MISSIONS.

Issue Priority Groups (IPGs) categorize works or material requisitions based on urgency, with IPG 1(highest) reserved for critical, mission-stopping, or immediate needs, often designated by priority codes (01-03), IPG 2 (04-08) and IPG 3 (09-15).
The julian date or proper code (777, 999) that relays to the provider when the materiel is required in order to support unit operations.

D_TO_MRO" IS 'set t.established_to_mro = round((t.ba_dt_min - t.established_dt), 4 ).
set t.mro_to_ship = case When t.as1_dt_max >= t.ba_dt_max  then round((t.as1_dt_max - t.ba_dt_max), 4 )  When t.ba_dt_max  >= t.as1_dt_max then abs(round((t.as1_dt_max - t.ba_dt_max), 4 )) end.

set t.ost = case When t.as1_dt_max <= t.d6_dt_max and round((nvl(t.as1_dt_max, t.ba_dt_max)  - t.established_dt),4) > 0 then round((nvl(t.as1_dt_max, t.ba_dt_max)  - t.established_dt),4)   When round((coalesce(t.ba_dt_max, t.d6_dt_max, t.dra_dt_max)- t.established_dt), 4) > 0                then round((coalesce(t.ba_dt_max, t.d6_dt_max, t.dra_dt_max)- t.established_dt), 4) end.
set t.lrt = round((nvl(t.d6_dt_max,  t.dra_dt_max) - t.established_dt),4).
set t.cwt = round((nvl(t.cor_dt_max, t.d6_dt_max)  - t.established_dt),4).
